posts.title: The living internet
posts.description: V.H. Belvadi in The living internet : There will always be someone who is looking to read what someone has written. We could help by continuing to write, and by celebrating others who are writing too. Share what others have written so more people can discover those who are writing. No, the internet isn't dead. Far from it. I read stuff written by real people every day. Some of it makes me chuckle.

posts.title: Assassin’s Fate by Robin Hobb
posts.description: Yesterday I finished Assassin's Fate by Robin Hobb. It marks the end of a journey. For Fitz and the Fool, and for myself. Over two years has passed since I picked up the first book in Robin Hobb's Realm of the Elderings series of books, Assassin's Apprentice .
